title: My most used app but a few important issues
body:
This is my single most used app, I use it for everything, but it’s got 3 issues that always “bugged” me.
1) randomly scrolls to the bottom of the note when you tap a word a certain way, super annoying
2) no real search function - it will find the note with the word you want but not where the word is in the note
3) Ad data sharing! I assumed my notes were personal but I have seen ads on Instagram pop up minutes after writing a note down in Keep about the same topic. Unacceptable breach of privacy! Let’s stop pretending this is okay.
